loss: absolute error averaged over all nodes, then over fitted seeds at each paired test origin
test: two-sided DM with lead-based Harvey correction and t(N-1) reference
primary_hac: Bartlett maximum lag h-1, matching the original analysis
multiplicity: Holm over 90 strategy-reference pairs separately within each dataset-base-lead setting and lag specification
missing_policy: Missing pairs are not tested or labelled non-significant; reserve their slots with p=1 solely for conservative Holm adjustment of available pairs
rank_summary: descriptive WAPE and sMASE ranks over 19 methods and 12 settings; no independence assumption or rank-based significance test
immutable: Preserve original tests, forecasts, rankings and model selections; no training or inference
